rules.rationale: The A13 commit introduced tradefed.jar and tradefed-tests.jar for its release snapshot. Android 16 contains current 25Q4 versions and references both from the current Tradefed prebuilt/dist definitions; copying the A13 binaries would downgrade host test infrastructure.
rules.necessity: Current Tradefed artifacts are required for host tests, but the A13 byte identities are not.
rules.performance: No target runtime cost. Retaining only the current snapshot avoids duplicate large JAR storage.
rules.security: Keeps test execution on the current source-aligned binaries rather than old opaque executables.
validation_evidence: Current tradefed.jar SHA-256 is 55f4f5e8f60ad7045ff0a6bb93e47d48c4638941d94d9249af5b58601bcf9a03; tradefed-tests.jar is 9c447dabd05c13e02ebf2f3b98817f5de3be1021d435afcfd724eaed913cc9b9.

rules.rationale: A13 added a 34 MB tradefed-test-framework.jar and a matching filegroup. The Android 16 prebuilt snapshot has removed both the file and filegroup; current test_harness consumes the consolidated current artifacts. Reintroducing the orphaned A13 JAR would not restore a live feature.
rules.necessity: Not necessary because no current module declares or consumes tradefed-test-framework-prebuilt.
rules.performance: Avoids 34 MB of duplicate repository and checkout storage.
rules.security: Avoids retaining an unreferenced old executable JAR with no current update path.
validation_evidence: A13 and Android-16 ls-tree plus filegroups/tradefed/Android.bp were compared directly; the current module is absent by design.
